confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Beer and restaurant anchors are moderate confidence. Accommodation is wider because it varies by neighbourhood and season, and July is treated as low season. Rand volatility adds drift. Cocktail and wine were set from their usual local price relationship to draft beer, since direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure came from a search summary of the RBA table and was not confirmed on the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparator city was used. The estimate reflects Cape Town's own central and Atlantic Seaboard tourist price levels, with accommodation loosely cross-checked against general South African tourist-city price bands.
